name: Store Analytics Lite for WooCommerce
author: Auscomp

sections.description:
Store Analytics Lite for WooCommerce provides a beautiful, privacy-focused analytics dashboard for your WooCommerce store. Get instant insights into your store’s performance with 6 essential KPIs, all processed locally on your server.

🎯 Core Features (LITE Version):
* Total Sales – Track revenue with period-over-period comparisons
* Orders – Monitor order volume and trends
* Orders by Category – See which product categories drive sales
* Net Profit – Understand your actual profitability
* Refund Rate – Monitor customer satisfaction and returns
* Average Order Value – Optimize your pricing strategy

🚀 PRO Features (Upgrade Required):
* Customer analytics (new vs returning)
* Repeat purchase rate tracking
* Coupon and discount impact analysis
* Returns by product insights
* Orders heatmap (day/hour patterns)
* World map sales visualization
* Top products performance
* Payment methods analysis

🔒 Privacy First:
* All data processed locally on your server
* No store data transmitted to third parties
* No external API calls or tracking
* GDPR compliant by design

🎨 Beautiful Interface:
* Dark/light theme toggle
* Responsive design for all devices
* Interactive charts and visualizations
* Customizable dashboard layout
* Drag-and-drop KPI card ordering

⚡ Performance Optimized:
* Fast loading with local asset bundling
* Efficient database queries
* Minimal server resource usage
* Optimized for high-traffic stores

Perfect for store owners who want professional analytics without compromising their data privacy or paying for expensive enterprise solutions.

Upgrade to PRO for advanced features and unlimited insights.

Privacy

This plugin processes all analytics data locally on your server. No store data, customer information, or analytics are transmitted to Auscomp or any third parties. Your data privacy is our top priority.

Support

For support, feature requests, or questions:
* Visit our website for more details and support

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/store-analytics-woo-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  4. Navigate to ‘Store Analytics Lite’ in your WordPress admin menu
  5. Start analyzing your store performance!

Requirements:
* WordPress 6.0 or higher
* WooCommerce 6.0 or higher
* PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send my store data anywhere?

No! All analytics are computed locally from your WooCommerce database. No store data is transmitted to Auscomp or any third parties. Your data stays 100% private.

Why is the dashboard empty in Live Preview?

The WordPress.org preview sandbox doesn’t include WooCommerce orders. Install on your store or enable demo data to see example KPIs.

What’s the difference between LITE and PRO versions?

The LITE version includes 6 core KPIs: Total Sales, Orders, Orders by Category, Net Profit, Refund Rate, and Average Order Value. The PRO version adds 8 advanced KPIs including customer analytics, heatmaps, world maps, and more detailed insights.

Will this plugin slow down my store?

No, the plugin is designed for minimal performance impact. It only loads on the admin dashboard and uses efficient database queries. All assets are bundled locally for fast loading.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes! Since all data is processed locally and never leaves your server, it’s fully GDPR compliant by design.

Can I customize the dashboard layout?

Yes! You can reorder KPI cards, adjust column widths, and toggle individual KPIs on/off through the dashboard settings panel.

Does this work with multisite?

Yes, the plugin works with WordPress multisite installations. Each site will have its own analytics dashboard.

What time periods can I analyze?

The plugin supports multiple time periods: today, yesterday, this week, last week, month to date, last 30 days, last month, this quarter, last quarter, this year, and last year.

Can I export the analytics data?

Currently, the plugin displays data in the dashboard interface. Export functionality is planned for future versions.

Is there a mobile app?

The dashboard is fully responsive and works great on mobile devices through your WordPress admin panel.

How often is the data updated?

Data is updated in real-time when you refresh the dashboard. The plugin queries your WooCommerce database directly for the most current information.
